# California Tenant Law

> > California Tenant Law provides free legal information, DIY kits, and professional services for renters facing eviction, security deposit disputes, and landlord-tenant conflicts throughout California.

Founded by Kenneth H. Carlson, J.D. (UC Berkeley, Loyola Law School, Bar #93602), this site offers comprehensive resources for California tenants including unlawful detainer defense, legal forms, case law research, and statewide attorney referrals. Services range from affordable DIY legal kits to full discovery and filing assistance.

## Key Topics

- Unlawful Detainer
- Eviction Defense
- California Civil Code
- Tenant Rights
- Security Deposit Recovery
- Foreclosure Tenant Protections
- Answer to Complaint
- Discovery Services
- Legal Forms and Kits
- Landlord-Tenant Law
- Default Relief Motions
- Demurrer
- Ken Carlson
- Breaking Your Lease
- Civil Code §2924.8

## Legal Kits & Self-Help Resources

- [Inexpensive Legal Kits](https://caltenantlaw.com/inexpensive-legal-kits/): DIY legal kits for eviction defense, trial, and security deposit recovery
- [Answer to Unlawful Detainer](https://caltenantlaw.com/answer/): Guide to preparing Answer to Unlawful Detainer Complaint and forms
- [Default Relief](https://caltenantlaw.com/default/): Default relief motions and court forms for eviction defense
- [Demurrer](https://caltenantlaw.com/demurrer/): Demurrer and motion to strike documents for complaint response
- [Foreclosure Tenant Rights](https://caltenantlaw.com/foreclosure/): Tenant rights guide for foreclosure under CA Civil Code §2924.8

## Professional Legal Services

- [Discovery Services](https://caltenantlaw.com/discovery-by-us/?category=0): Discovery services for unlawful detainer and tenant defense cases
- [Extra Services](https://caltenantlaw.com/extra-services/): Additional legal services including filing and process service for tenants
- [Tenant Lawyers Directory](https://caltenantlaw.com/lawyers/): Directory of trusted tenant attorneys across California cities

## Legal Research & Reference

- [Laws and Legal Research](https://caltenantlaw.com/laws/): CA Civil Code, CCP statutes, and case law research for tenant rights
